newsitem.title: USA: GM raises Q1 North American output forecast.
newsitem.headline: GM raises Q1 North American output forecast.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Friday it boosted its first quarter North American production plans by 18,000 to 1,431,000 vehicles, a 17 percent increase over the 1,219,000 vehicles made in the 1996 first quarter.
GM said it plans to build 776,000 cars and 655,000 trucks in the 1997 first quarter.
For all of January, GM made 486,000 vehicles in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, versus 451,000 a year ago. Of the January 1997 figures, 264,000 were cars and 222,000 trucks.
